Printed labels read Anti-MOG antibodies at the top, Anti-NMDAR antibodies at the upper left, Autoreactive Plasma Cell at the right of the top, Anti-neuronal antibodies at the right middle and Autoreactive B Lymphocyte at the lower left. A purple arrow runs from the oval cell toward antibodies above the head.

visual.general_description: Timeline graphic with grey boxes of events from childbirth to day 44, including BFCRS scores 35, 15 and 5.
visual.detailed_description: A titled timeline with ten time labels on a bottom bar and boxed descriptions of childbirth, stressors, weaning, behavioral onset, outside emergency care, hospitalizations, treatments, rituximab and BFCRS scores.

panels.general_description: Horizontal disease timeline with boxed event descriptions above a bar of printed time labels, titled Disease Timeline.
panels.detailed_description: A white-background timeline with the title Disease Timeline in bold at the top. A horizontal bar at the bottom prints time labels in order: Fall, Winter, Spring - Day 1, Spring - Day 2, Day 3, Days 3-12, Day 13, Days 14-17, Day 34 and Day 44. Grey rounded boxes sit at different heights, each joined to its time label by a thin vertical line. The boxes print: Child born with Sickle Cell Disease (Fall); Increasing stressors: sickle cell disease in child, childcare, returning to work and Prodrome: Increasing anxiety behaviors (Winter); Infant weaned; Acute behavioral change: Anxiety, Called boss crying, Insomnia (Spring - Day 1); Bizarre behavior onset: speaking with unseen others, repeating words, increased energy, strange movements, tremors, facial grimacing, rigidity, Cleaning house non-stop and Auditory and visual hallucinations (Spring - Day 2); Presented to outside emergency department and Rejected by inpatient psychiatry (Day 3); Medical hospitalization and work-up at outside hospital (Days 3-12); Presented to our institution and BFCRS 35 (Day 13); lorazepam, IV methylprednisone, IVIG, amantadine and divalproex (Days 14-17); Intermittently verbal, BFCRS 15 and Rituximab (Day 34); BFCRS 5 (Day 44).
